stances_toward.note: NATO ally and Pristina's patron too; Albania is a founding member of Trump's Board of Peace (parliament voted 110 of 140 on 22 Jan 2026, no fee) and the Kushner family's Affinity Partners holds the Sazan/Zvernec concession. Stable because the political tie is intense and the economic tie thin ('extremely weak, despite excellent diplomatic ties'); Albania got only the base 10% tariff and its exports to the US fell about 30% in April 2025; the 2027 NATO summit in Albania is in doubt with US reluctance cited. Bond - affinity: the 1999 Kosovo war made the US Albania's declared ally (per the Wikipedia index).

stances_toward.note: Charter on Strategic Partnership signed in Washington on 14 Jan 2025 (commission, nuclear 123 agreement talks, customs and border team, Armenia joining the anti-ISIS coalition), the 8 Aug 2025 White House summit, a Vance visit (Feb 2026) and a Charter on Comprehensive Strategic Partnership signed in Yerevan by Rubio on 26 May 2026 together with an initialled TRIPP framework and a critical-minerals memorandum; Trump endorsed Pashinyan before the election and congratulated him on 11 Jun 2026. 'Partner', not 'ally': no defence commitment in any document (Armenian analysts note the charter has no security guarantee and no significant military aid) and the whole structure depends on Washington's attention. Bond - affinity: a large diaspora and Congress-level sympathy, not kinship.

On the other hand the State Department warned Sarajevo against delay on leaving Russian gas and the US-backed Southern Interconnection continues. stances_toward.note: Strategic dialogue launched in Washington on 17 July 2026; Vučić told Fox News relations were 'dramatically transformed'. Documented friction over NIS sanctions, tariffs and Kosovo. Bond - grievance: the 1999 NATO bombing and the 2008 recognition of Kosovo; about half of Serbians regard the US as an enemy (poll via N1). Structural check: Washington is also Pristina's de facto guarantor (KFOR, Javelins, Board of Peace charter of Jan 2026, see XKX); Belgrade's 'partner' grade rests on transactional gains (strategic dialogue, NIS licences) and on the Trump administration's perceived softness on Kosovo (Vučić, N1, March 2026), not on any shared position on Kosovo.

stances_toward.note: Transactional, and it should not be read as an alliance: no treaty, direct US funding stopped in early 2025 (Kiel), the Trump administration asked the General Assembly on 24 Feb 2026 to drop the territorial-integrity paragraphs (69 to 11 against) and then abstained, and the Iran war froze the talks from March. Yet Washington remains the supplier Kyiv cannot replace (about 95% of Patriot interceptors reach Ukraine through PURL, paid by allies), the minerals fund has made its first deals, and the line changed in July 2026: at Ankara Trump promised a licence to build Patriot missiles and said he wants Ukrainian drones, then received Zelensky at the White House on 28 July. Trend: warming since July, with a Miami round on 9-10 Oct. Bond - none: pure interest after the US voted against Ukraine's resolution in Feb 2025.
